votes.motion: to recommend approval of the proposed exception to allow a pitched roof in the C-MU zone based on the findings the proposal meets the criteria for an exception and site plan of the Ogden Downtown District. Approval is subject to the following conditions: 1. The slope of the butterfly roof be flattened to be between 10.04% to 8.33%; 2. The applicant must complete the encroachment permit process with City Engineering; 3. The applicant is to make the required corrections to the site plan drawings and finish the site plan review process before construction plans can be submitted for review. Motion
